## "The more storage you have, the more stuff you accumulate."

Need a place to stash that hard drive of sensitive corporate data? That datapad filled with 45 terabytes of foot-tentacle porn weighing you down? How about a safe spot where you can log your credits in lieu of carrying around cred-sticks and having them jacked by a ganger? Server banks have got you covered. These facilities are open to the public and have some of the strictest Enforcers and Hackers to safeguard your data, be it physical or digital. Server banks biolock your data and ensure no remake or poser can hack into your private life without extensive background checks.

Older server banks double as bergs, data storehouses for more long-term if not permanent cold cases and profiles. Rumor has it that a few bergs in the outskirts are actually Engram storage facilities for the most dangerous criminals caught by NCPD, The Scriptorium, or even laboratories for APEX’s remake program. It’s uncanny to some to see that most of these facilities have a peaceful atmosphere despite the most horrid being known to man living within their walls: lawyers and accountants.

Public banks tend to have at least one teller in association with either the Reliquary or the Umbral Scriptorium—sometimes multiple—for purposes of accurate accounting and record keeping. Which of the two is present depends on just how far from surface access the bank is.
